# Enum | Clean Code Editor for Mobile

A high-performance code editor designed specifically for mobile devices. It enables smooth handling of over 10,000 lines of code.

## Access
- [Open Enum Editor](https://enum-enb.pages.dev): Launch the application directly in your browser.

## Project Structure
- [index.html](https://enum-enb.pages.dev/index.html): The core file containing the application interface, CSS styles, and JavaScript logic, consolidated for optimized performance.

## Usage
The application runs directly in any modern mobile web browser. No local installation is required.
